Subject: Discovery recap: Redwood + Brightware - next steps

Hi Lucas / Katie —

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through Brightware's latency-sensitive recommendation workload earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard:
- 6M monthly inference requests, 95th pct latency target ~120ms (P50 ~30ms)
- Currently using a mix of on-prem GPUs and cloud endpoints; biggest pain points are inconsistent tail latency and cost spikes during batch jobs
- Data residency and audit logs are required for production (PCI-adjacent)

What Redwood can help with (high level):
- Unified runtime to serve your transformer models with predictable latencies across hosted and private deploys
- Prefix/KV caching and dynamic batching to cut token cost without sacrificing tail SLOs
- Audit logs + KMS integration for compliance

Proposed next steps:
1) 30–45 minute technical POC planning call with your infra team + our SEs to scope a short pilot (2 models, 2 week run).
2) We’ll share a tailored POC plan and estimated cost delta.
3) If POC looks good, draft mutual action plan and timeline for a Q3 rollout.

I’ve attached the deck from today (Redwood_Discovery_Deck_Brightware.pdf) and a short one-pager with our POC checklist. Does next week look good for a quick sync (Tue/Wed preferred)? If your priority has shifted, let me know and I can follow up at a better time.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
